_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Data Description profile UML. Sources: metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfiles/CDIFDataDescriptionProfile/CDIFDataDescriptionProfileSchema.json and ../../cdifProperties/cdifDataDescription/cdifDataDescriptionSchema.json. Data Description composes Core + cdifDataDescription. On top of Discovery's variableMeasured, this profile adds variable-level physicalDataType, distribution-level file characterization (characterSet, fileSize), plus the cdif:hasPrimaryKey and cdif:statistics extension points. This config defines the additions only; the full UML is assembled by composing CDIFCore + CDIFDiscovery + this profile. Conforms-to: https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.0.

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF Data Description Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Data Description Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Data-description additions over CDIF Discovery: variable physicalDataType, file characterization, primary key, statistics
targetModel.definition: CDIF Data Description profile - extends Discovery with detailed variable descriptions (physicalDataType), distribution file characterization (character set, file size), primary key declarations, and statistical summaries.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Data Description profile additions on top of Core + Discovery.

package.name: Variables
package.definition: Variable description classes (InstanceVariable subset used in Data Description).

package.name: Distribution
package.definition: Distribution-level extensions: file characterization, the PhysicalDataSet subclasses (TabularTextDataSet, StructuredDataSet), the physical-mapping family (PhysicalMapping, TextMapping, LocatorMapping), and the DataFingerprint datatype.

package.name: Statistics
package.definition: Statistic value object plus Statistics, CategoryStatistics, StatisticsCollection and Category for cdif:statistics (cdifProperties/cdifStatistics).

package.name: ValueDomains
package.definition: SubstantiveValueDomain, SentinelValueDomain and EnumerationDomain for the value domains an InstanceVariable draws its values from (cdifProperties/cdifValueDomain).

package.name: Support
package.definition: Supporting structured types: Identifier, DefinedTerm, Reference (stubs; full definitions in CDIFCore).

class._comment: AbstractVariable - abstract supertype of VariableMeasured (schema:PropertyValue form) and InstanceVariable (cdi:InstanceVariable form). The Dataset_variableMeasured association targets this single end; the JSON instance carries the concrete schema:PropertyValue or cdi:InstanceVariable in @type. Value domains and statistics attach to the concrete InstanceVariable; the lightweight schema.org wrapper attributes live on VariableMeasured.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for the value of schema:variableMeasured - either a VariableMeasured (schema:PropertyValue) or a cdi:InstanceVariable. Concrete subclasses: VariableMeasured, InstanceVariable.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI for the variable.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name / cdi:name - variable name.

class._comment: InstanceVariable as referenced by schema:variableMeasured at the Data Description level. Adds physicalDataType, describedUnitOfMeasure, unitOfMeasureKind, role. Mapped from DDI-CDI InstanceVariable directly. Generalizes AbstractVariable; value domains and statistics attach here.

attribute._comment: Flatten DDI-CDI ControlledVocabularyEntry source type to a skos:Concept reference (CDIF profile policy).
attribute.name: describedUnitOfMeasure

attribute._comment: Flatten DDI-CDI ControlledVocabularyEntry source type to a skos:Concept reference (CDIF profile policy).
attribute.name: unitOfMeasureKind
function
attribute.definition: cdi:function - immutable characteristic of the variable (geographic designator, weight, temporal designation, ...).

attribute.name: platformType
attribute.definition: cdi:platformType - the application/technical system context in which the variable was realized.

attribute.name: source
attribute.definition: cdi:source - provenance information for this InstanceVariable.

attribute.name: hasIntendedDataType
attribute.definition: cdi:hasIntendedDataType - the data type intended for this variable, independent of its physical representation.

attribute.name: simpleUnitOfMeasure
attribute.definition: cdif:simpleUnitOfMeasure - plain-string unit of measure (use describedUnitOfMeasure for a controlled-vocabulary unit).

attribute.name: uses
attribute.definition: cdif:uses - concept(s) this variable measures or represents (akin to schema:propertyID).

class._comment: VariableMeasured wrapper that the Data Description profile uses as the value of schema:variableMeasured. Holds the cdif:physicalDataType required at this profile level.
class.definition: schema:variableMeasured payload at the Data Description level. Wraps a DDI-CDI InstanceVariable reference with additional CDIF-required properties: cdif:physicalDataType and (optionally) cdif:role. Generalizes AbstractVariable.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI for this variable description.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - short variable name.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - human-readable description.

attribute.name: propertyId
attribute.definition: schema:propertyID - URI of the property concept.

attribute.name: unitText
attribute.definition: schema:unitText - unit of measure as text.

attribute.name: unitCode
attribute.definition: schema:unitCode - URI for the unit.

attribute._comment: Per CDIF profile policy: DDI-CDI's cdi:physicalDataType (originally a ControlledVocabularyEntry / PairedControlledVocabularyEntry structured DataType) is implemented as a skos:Concept reference. The Concept stub lives in this profile so the type is locally resolvable; the canonical SKOS Concept definition lives in the CDIFCodelist profile (cross-profile linked in the HTML).
attribute.name: physicalDataType
attribute.definition: cdif:physicalDataType / cdi:physicalDataType - XSD-style data type for the physical representation, expressed as a reference to a skos:Concept in a controlled vocabulary (e.g. XSD-types scheme). Required at the Data Description level.

attribute.name: role
attribute.definition: cdif:role - role of this variable in the data set (Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension). At the Data Structure level this lives on the component class instead.

class._comment: PhysicalDataSet-based file characterization. Mapped from DDI-CDI PhysicalDataSet with file-level attributes.
class.definition: schema:DataDownload extended for the Data Description profile - adds the character-set attribute, the per-field physical mappings (cdif:hasPhysicalMapping), and a data fingerprint (cdi:fingerprint). File size is carried by the Core schema:contentSize attribute. Co-typed cdi:PhysicalDataSet in instances; TabularTextDataSet and StructuredDataSet specialize it for text-tabular and structured serializations. Composes with the core DataDownload at the model-composition step.

attribute.name: characterSet
attribute.definition: cdi:characterSet - character encoding of a text-based distribution (e.g. UTF-8). Required by CDIF Data Description for text distributions.

attribute.name: fingerprint
attribute.definition: cdi:fingerprint - a fingerprint (checksum/hash) of the physical dataset, used to verify integrity.

class._comment: PrimaryKey - target of cdif:hasPrimaryKey on the dataset.

Statistic value object - a single computed value (mean, count, median ...). DDI-CDI Statistic dataType; no identity, carried inline inside a Statistics/CategoryStatistics bundle. isDataType:true per the value-type policy. From cdifProperties/cdifStatistics.
class.definition: cdi:Statistic - a single computed statistical value. A value object carried inline inside a Statistics or CategoryStatistics bundle.

attribute.name: computationBase
attribute.definition: cdi:computationBase - cases included in the statistic: Total, ValidOnly, or MissingOnly.

attribute.name: content
attribute.definition: cdi:content - the value of the statistic expressed as a real number.

attribute.name: isWeighted
attribute.definition: cdi:isWeighted - true if the statistic was computed using a weighting variable.

attribute.name: typeOfNumericValue
attribute.definition: cdi:typeOfNumericValue - the type of numeric value in content (decimal, float, double).

class._comment: Statistics - a named bundle of one or more Statistic value objects for an instance variable, optionally weighted, optionally broken down by Category. Target of cdif:statistics. From cdifProperties/cdifStatistics.
class.definition: cdi:Statistics - a named bundle of Statistic value objects for an instance variable.

attribute.name: typeOfStatistic
attribute.definition: cdi:typeOfStatistic - controlled-vocabulary entry naming the kind of statistic (mean, median, count, sum, stdDev ...).

attribute.name: statistic
attribute.definition: cdi:statistic - ordered list of Statistic value objects carried by this bundle.

class._comment: CategoryStatistics - statistics for a specific Category of an instance variable. From cdifProperties/cdifStatistics.
class.definition: cdi:CategoryStatistics - statistics for a specific Category of an instance variable within a data set.

attribute.name: typeOfStatistic
attribute.definition: cdi:typeOfStatistic - controlled-vocabulary entry naming the kind of statistic.

attribute.name: statistic
attribute.definition: cdi:statistic - per-category Statistic value objects.

class._comment: StatisticsCollection - groups one or more Statistics nodes for an instance variable (e.g. row-count / mean / stddev per measured variable). Target of cdif:statistics. From cdifProperties/cdifStatistics.
class.definition: cdi:StatisticsCollection - groups one or more Statistics nodes for an instance variable.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - identifier for this StatisticsCollection node.

class._comment: Category - minimal Category shape used as a CategoryStatistics target. CDIF simplifies the DDI-CDI InternationalString/LabelForDisplay/ObjectName valued properties to plain strings. From cdifProperties/cdifStatistics.
class.definition: cdi:Category - a category of an instance variable, as the subject of CategoryStatistics.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: cdif:name - human-understandable name(s). CDIF-simplified from DDI-CDI Category.name (ObjectName).

attribute.name: descriptiveText
attribute.definition: cdif:descriptiveText - short natural-language account of the category.

attribute.name: definition
attribute.definition: cdif:definition - natural-language definition of the category.

attribute.name: displayLabel
attribute.definition: cdif:displayLabel - human-readable display label(s).

class._comment: SubstantiveValueDomain - the set of valid, meaningful values for a variable (cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom). From cdifProperties/cdifValueDomain. At the Data Description level value domains attach to the InstanceVariable directly; at the Data Structure level they attach to the RepresentedVariable instead. Mapped 1:1 from DDI-CDI.

attribute.name: displayLabel
attribute.definition: cdif:displayLabel - human-readable display label for the value domain.

attribute.name: recommendedDataType
attribute.definition: cdif:recommendedDataType - the data type(s) recommended for use with this domain (xsd type token).

class._comment: SentinelValueDomain - missing / not-applicable value codes for a variable (cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom). From cdifProperties/cdifValueDomain. Mapped 1:1 from DDI-CDI.

attribute.name: displayLabel
attribute.definition: cdif:displayLabel - human-readable display label for the value domain.

attribute.name: recommendedDataType
attribute.definition: cdif:recommendedDataType - the data type(s) recommended for use with this domain (xsd type token).

class._comment: ValueAndConceptDescription - formal description of the values/concepts a value domain admits (cdi:ValueAndConceptDescription): ranges, patterns, classification level, regular/logical expressions, etc. Target of cdi:isDescribedBy on the substantive/sentinel value domains. From cdifProperties/cdifValueDomain.
EnumerationDomain - the enumerated set of codes a value domain draws from (cdif:takesValuesFrom). From cdifProperties/cdifEnumerationDomain. Mapped 1:1 from DDI-CDI.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: cdif:identifier - identifier for this enumerated (categorical) domain.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - human-understandable name of the enumeration domain.

attribute.name: references
attribute.definition: cdif:references - URI of the SKOS ConceptScheme that contains the concepts defining the allowed values of this enumeration domain.

attribute.name: purpose
attribute.definition: cdif:purpose - intent or reason for the object / the description of the object.

class._comment: PhysicalMapping - serialization-agnostic base for the per-field physical representation of a variable in a distribution file (cdif:hasPhysicalMapping). From cdifProperties/cdifPhysicalMapping. The text-format specifics (column width, decimal/digit-group separators, display label) live on the TextMapping subclass; locator-based addressing lives on the LocatorMapping subclass (both generalize PhysicalMapping). mappingType=new because the CDIF flat per-column structure has no 1:1 class in DDI-CDI 1.1beta.
class.definition: Per-field physical mapping linking a variable measured by a distribution to its physical representation in the file - column index, format, physical data type, number pattern, null sequence, etc. (cdif:hasPhysicalMapping items). TextMapping and LocatorMapping specialize it for text-tabular and structured (locator) data respectively.

attribute.name: index
attribute.definition: cdif:index - non-negative integer that orders the fields in the data structure (column number).

attribute.name: format
attribute.definition: cdif:format - format for a number expressed as a string, or a date format such as YYYY/MM or MM-DD-YY.

attribute.name: physicalDataType
attribute.definition: cdif:physicalDataType - physical data type of the column, expressed as a string.

attribute.name: numberPattern
attribute.definition: cdi:numberPattern - number format pattern for the field (PhysicalMapping.numberPattern). Column width and decimal/digit-group separators live on the TextMapping subclass.

attribute.name: nullSequence
attribute.definition: cdi:nullSequence - the value used as the null annotation for the described column.

attribute.name: defaultValue
attribute.definition: cdi:defaultValue - default string to substitute for an empty string.

attribute.name: scale
attribute.definition: cdi:scale - scale of the numeric value.

attribute.name: decimalPositions
attribute.definition: cdi:decimalPositions - number of decimal positions.

attribute.name: minimumLength
attribute.definition: cdi:minimumLength - minimum length of the column value.

attribute.name: maximumLength
attribute.definition: cdi:maximumLength - maximum length of the column value.

attribute.name: isRequired
attribute.definition: cdi:isRequired - whether a value is required for this column.

class._comment: TextMapping - per-field physical mapping for a variable in a delimited or fixed-width text data set. DDI-CDI TextMapping, a subclass of PhysicalMapping; adds column width and number-formatting detail. From cdifProperties/cdifTextMapping (allOf cdifPhysicalMapping). cdif:formats_InstanceVariable and the base mapping attributes are inherited from PhysicalMapping.
class.definition: DDI-CDI TextMapping - physical mapping for a variable in a delimited or fixed-width text data set, extending PhysicalMapping with column width and number-formatting properties.

attribute.name: length
attribute.definition: cdi:length - the column width if the tabular text is fixed width (TextMapping.length).

attribute.name: defaultDecimalSeparator
attribute.definition: cdi:defaultDecimalSeparator - decimal separator used when not otherwise specified (TextMapping.defaultDecimalSeparator).

attribute.name: defaultDigitGroupSeparator
attribute.definition: cdi:defaultDigitGroupSeparator - digit-group (thousands) separator (TextMapping.defaultDigitGroupSeparator).

attribute.name: displayLabel
attribute.definition: cdif:displayLabel - human-readable label(s) for display. CDIF simplification (plain string) of DDI-CDI TextMapping.displayLabel (LabelForDisplay).

class._comment: LocatorMapping - locates a variable's value(s) within a structured (hierarchical) data set (XML/JSON) via a locator expression. DDI-CDI LocatorMapping, a subclass of PhysicalMapping. From cdifProperties/cdifLocatorMapping. Used in place of column-index/text mappings for cdi:StructuredDataSet distributions; cdif:formats_InstanceVariable is inherited from PhysicalMapping.
class.definition: DDI-CDI LocatorMapping - locates a variable's value(s) in a structured document (XPath, JSONPath, pointer, ...) for a cdi:StructuredDataSet distribution.

attribute.name: locator
attribute.definition: cdi:locator - expression locating the variable's value(s) in the structured document (XPath, JSONPath, pointer, etc.). LocatorMapping.locator.

class._comment: TabularTextDataSet - dataset-level physical layout of a delimited or fixed-width text data set (CSV/TSV/fixed-width). DDI-CDI TabularTextDataSet, a subclass of PhysicalDataSet (= schema:DataDownload). Carried as a co-type on the distribution. From cdifProperties/cdifTabularTextDataSet. Per-field mappings are TextMapping (on cdif:hasPhysicalMapping, inherited from DataDownload).
class.definition: DDI-CDI TabularTextDataSet - dataset-level physical layout properties of a delimited or fixed-width text distribution; a subclass of PhysicalDataSet (= schema:DataDownload).

attribute.name: arrayBase
attribute.definition: cdi:arrayBase - index of the first element/column (TabularTextDataSet.arrayBase).

attribute.name: commentPrefix
attribute.definition: cdi:commentPrefix - character(s) that mark a line as a comment.

attribute.name: delimiter
attribute.definition: cdi:delimiter - field delimiter (e.g. ',' or tab).

attribute.name: escapeCharacter
attribute.definition: cdi:escapeCharacter - character used to escape the delimiter or quote within a field.

attribute.name: hasHeader
attribute.definition: cdi:hasHeader - whether the file has a header row.

attribute.name: headerIsCaseSensitive
attribute.definition: cdi:headerIsCaseSensitive - whether header matching is case sensitive.

attribute.name: headerRowCount
attribute.definition: cdi:headerRowCount - number of header rows.

attribute.name: isDelimited
attribute.definition: cdi:isDelimited - whether the file is delimited.

attribute.name: isFixedWidth
attribute.definition: cdi:isFixedWidth - whether the file is fixed-width.

attribute.name: lineTerminator
attribute.definition: cdi:lineTerminator - allowed line terminators, in order (default [CRLF, LF]).

attribute.name: nullSequence
attribute.definition: cdi:nullSequence - value interpreted as null at the dataset level.

attribute.name: quoteCharacter
attribute.definition: cdi:quoteCharacter - character used to quote fields.

attribute.name: skipBlankRows
attribute.definition: cdi:skipBlankRows - whether blank rows are skipped.

attribute.name: skipDataColumns
attribute.definition: cdi:skipDataColumns - number of leading data columns to skip.

attribute.name: skipInitialSpace
attribute.definition: cdi:skipInitialSpace - whether to skip whitespace after the delimiter.

attribute.name: skipRows
attribute.definition: cdi:skipRows - number of leading rows to skip.

attribute.name: tableDirection
attribute.definition: cdi:tableDirection - direction in which columns are arranged in each row (TableDirectionValues enumeration: Auto, Ltr, Rtl).

attribute.name: textDirection
attribute.definition: cdi:textDirection - reading order of text within cells (TextDirectionValues enumeration: Auto, Inherit, Ltr, Rtl).

attribute.name: treatConsecutiveDelimitersAsOne
attribute.definition: cdi:treatConsecutiveDelimitersAsOne - whether consecutive delimiters are treated as a single delimiter.

attribute.name: trim
attribute.definition: cdi:trim - which spaces to remove from a data value (TrimValues enumeration: Both, End, Neither, Start).

class._comment: StructuredDataSet - dataset-level marker for a structured (hierarchical) data set (XML/JSON). DDI-CDI StructuredDataSet, a subclass of PhysicalDataSet (= schema:DataDownload). Fields are located with LocatorMapping rather than column-index/text mappings. From cdifProperties/cdifStructuredDataSet.
class.definition: DDI-CDI StructuredDataSet - dataset-level marker for a structured (hierarchical) distribution; a subclass of PhysicalDataSet (= schema:DataDownload). Fields are addressed with LocatorMapping.

attribute.name: encoding
attribute.definition: cdif:encoding - character encoding / serialization of the structured document (e.g. utf-8, application/json). CDIF simplification (plain charset string) of DDI-CDI PhysicalDataSet.encoding (ControlledVocabularyEntry).

class._comment: DataFingerprint - a fingerprint (checksum/hash) of a physical dataset, used to verify integrity. DDI-CDI DataFingerprint datatype (StructuredDataTypes); carried inline on a DataDownload via cdi:fingerprint. isDataType:true per the value-type policy. From cdifProperties/cdifDataFingerprint.
class.definition: DDI-CDI DataFingerprint - a fingerprint (checksum/hash) of a physical dataset, used to verify integrity.

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: cdi:value - the fingerprint value (e.g. the hex digest). DataFingerprint.value.

attribute.name: algorithmSpecification
attribute.definition: cdi:algorithmSpecification - identifier or name of the algorithm specification (e.g. SHA-256, MD5). DataFingerprint.algorithmSpecification.

attribute.name: algorithmVersion
attribute.definition: cdi:algorithmVersion - version of the fingerprint algorithm/specification. DataFingerprint.algorithmVersion.

attribute.name: typeOfFingerprint
attribute.definition: cdi:typeOfFingerprint - the kind of fingerprint (e.g. checksum, hash, digest). DataFingerprint.typeOfFingerprint.

class._comment: skos:Concept stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'Concept' (e.g. InstanceVariable.physicalDataType) resolve inside this profile. The canonical SKOS Concept definition lives in the CDIFCodelist profile; cross-profile HTML links point readers there. DDI-CDI's PairedControlledVocabularyEntry / ControlledVocabularyEntry are implemented across CDIF profiles as references to skos:Concept.
class.definition: skos:Concept (stub). A reference to a controlled-vocabulary term defined in a SKOS ConceptScheme; full definition in CDIFCodelist::Concept.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this concept.

attribute.name: prefLabel
attribute.definition: skos:prefLabel - preferred lexical label.

attribute.name: inScheme
attribute.definition: skos:inScheme - URI of the owning ConceptScheme.

sssom.comment: CDIF profiles flatten the DDI-CDI scheme+term DataType into a plain skos:Concept reference. The Concept definition itself lives in CDIFCodelist.

class._comment: Identifier (schema:PropertyValue) stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'Identifier' resolve inside this profile; the canonical definition lives in the CDIFCore profile.
class.definition: schema:PropertyValue / schema:Identifier (stub). A structured identifier with a propertyID (scheme), value, and optional url. Full definition in CDIFCore::Identifier.

attribute.name: propertyId
attribute.definition: schema:propertyID - the identifier scheme (e.g. DOI, Handle, ROR).

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: schema:value - the identifier value.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - resolvable form of the identifier.

class._comment: DefinedTerm (schema:DefinedTerm) stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'DefinedTerm' resolve inside this profile; the canonical definition lives in the CDIFCore profile.
class.definition: schema:DefinedTerm (stub). A controlled-vocabulary term with name, code, and scheme URI. Full definition in CDIFCore::DefinedTerm.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id / schema:identifier - URI for the term.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - the term's preferred label.

attribute.name: termCode
attribute.definition: schema:termCode - code value within the term set.

attribute.name: inDefinedTermSet
attribute.definition: schema:inDefinedTermSet - URI of the controlled vocabulary.

association._comment: schema:variableMeasured targets the AbstractVariable supertype (either a VariableMeasured/schema:PropertyValue or a cdi:InstanceVariable). targetAssociationName is kept as ..._VariableMeasured so it overrides (dedups) the Discovery profile's Dataset_variableMeasured_VariableMeasured at composition; objectClass retargets the actual end to AbstractVariable, so the emitted association is Dataset_variableMeasured_AbstractVariable.
association.definition: schema:variableMeasured - variables described at the Data Description level. The AbstractVariable supertype admits a VariableMeasured (schema:PropertyValue) or a cdi:InstanceVariable.
Links the schema:variableMeasured wrapper to the DDI-CDI InstanceVariable being described.
cdif:hasPrimaryKey - the primary key declared for the dataset.

association._comment: cdif:statistics - a dataset reports statistical summaries as Statistics bundles ...
association.definition: cdif:statistics - Statistics bundles (one or more Statistic value objects) reported on the dataset.

association._comment: cdif:statistics - ... or as StatisticsCollections grouping several Statistics nodes.
association.definition: cdif:statistics - StatisticsCollections grouping several Statistics nodes reported on the dataset.
cdif:appliesTo - the InstanceVariable(s) this Statistics bundle summarizes.
cdi:hasWeight - the InstanceVariable whose values were used as weights when computing the statistics.
cdif:has_CategoryStatistics - CategoryStatistics entries breaking this Statistics bundle down by Category.
cdi:for - the Category this CategoryStatistics is for.
cdi:hasWeight - the InstanceVariable whose values were used as weights.
cdif:has_Statistics - the Statistics nodes carried by this collection.
cdif:indexedBy - the InstanceVariable(s) the contained Statistics index.
cdi:hasWeight - the InstanceVariable whose values were used as weights.
cdif:isDescribedBy_StatisticsCollection - the StatisticsCollection holding summary / category statistics for this InstanceVariable.
cdi:qualifies - reference to another instance variable that this variable qualifies.

association._comment: cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom. DDI-CDI carries this on RepresentedVariable; at the Data Description profile level CDIF attaches the value domain to the InstanceVariable directly, so this is declared as a new association (no DDI-CDI source association from InstanceVariable).
association.definition: cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom - the substantive value domain (the set of valid, meaningful values) for this variable.

association._comment: cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom. As above, attached to InstanceVariable at the Data Description level; declared as a new association.
association.definition: cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom - the sentinel (missing / not-applicable) value domain(s) for this variable.

association._comment: cdif:takesValuesFrom - a substantive value domain draws its values from an enumerated set. Mapped 1:1 from the DDI-CDI source association.
cdif:takesValuesFrom - a sentinel value domain draws its values from an enumerated set. Mapped 1:1 from the DDI-CDI source association.
cdi:isDescribedBy - a substantive value domain is described by a ValueAndConceptDescription (ranges, patterns, classification level, expressions). Mapped 1:1 from the DDI-CDI source association.
cdi:isDescribedBy - a sentinel value domain is described by a ValueAndConceptDescription. Mapped 1:1 from the DDI-CDI source association.
cdif:hasPhysicalMapping - per-field physical mappings for a DataDownload distribution typed as a physical data set. New association (CDIF flattening; no DDI-CDI source association).
association.definition: cdif:hasPhysicalMapping - per-field physical mappings linking the variables measured by this distribution to their physical representation in the file.

association._comment: cdif:formats_InstanceVariable - the variable in schema:variableMeasured that this physical mapping formats. New association (CDIF flattening of DDI-CDI ValueMapping_formats_DataPoint / InstanceVariable_has_ValueMapping).
association.definition: cdif:formats_InstanceVariable - reference to the variable defined in schema:variableMeasured that this physical mapping formats.
